BYTESHELF_ROOT.description: Root folder for the database, objects and keys, owned by the user the server runs as

ASPNETCORE_URLS.description: Where the server listens, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5000 behind a reverse proxy

BYTESHELF_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated IPs or CIDR ranges of the reverse proxies in front of the server

POSTMARK_API_KEY.description: Postmark server token; without it no email is sent

EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS.description: Address mail is from, a sender confirmed in Postmark; required with POSTMARK_API_KEY

EMAIL_FROM_NAME.description: Name mail is from (ByteShelf by default)

INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: First admin's email, created while there are no users; remove once it exists

INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: First admin's password; remove once it exists

BYTESHELF_RESTORE_WINDOW_DAYS.description: Days a deletion can be restored before it is purged (30 by default)

BYTESHELF_REPLICATION_ALERT_MINUTES.description: Minutes replication may go wrong before the admins are emailed (60 by default)
